note: paper config (open_room_door specialist): r = min(X6, 0.3 cm); 13-chunk windows, the first 7 train; skip groups with a range below 0.5 cm; lr 1e-4, 24 steps per round, warmup 12, EMA 0.5, beta 0.1, reference weight 1, clip 1; LoRA r32/a32; reward scale frozen at r00. Start pool: 80 scenes x 4 teacher seeds, each capped at 66 chunks; 16 probe + 64 training scenes; 64 training starts x 8 candidates per round; full-episode evaluation before r00 and after every 5th round on the probe scenes x 2 to the 60 s horizon; at most 15 rounds. rows 8 and sampled rendering as in the paper runs. The paper specialist is round r04 (chosen by the in-training evaluation). Acceleration: rows only changes throughput (starts, candidates, seeds, samples per round and gradient batches are unchanged); row-batched and row-by-row sampling agree only to bf16 rounding, so trajectories are not bit-identical (with rows 1 every candidate rebuilds its start history on its own, which is much slower). render_mode sampled gives bit-identical policy frames. rows, learn_batch and render_mode may change when a run resumes.
